title: INVOL (DT/COP) ? VOL (CC ADDCOL No ACNP, +ve Later) � Positive VOL Deducted from Delay
description:
AC applied a DT day-of-travel schedule change (INVOL), then customer called the Contact Center and voluntarily changed to an even LATER flight (ADDCOL + no ACNP = +ve VOL). The extra 2 hours the customer added by going later is DEDUCTED from the total delay. Validates positive VOL deduction logic after DT.
